name: loop-plugins
description: Loop AI public Claude Code plugins: oncall (Grafana Loki queries, root cause analysis, on-call health report), engg (git and PR lifecycle, code review, codebase investigation, plans and design docs, review agents) and platform-engineer (an orchestrating skill that routes tasks through the other two and keeps durable workstream state)

plugins.name: oncall
plugins.description: On-call and incident response skills: Grafana Loki log queries, structured root cause analysis, and an on-call health report

plugins.name: engg
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills: git and PR lifecycle, code review, codebase investigation, planning and design docs, plus two review agents

plugins.name: platform-engineer
plugins.description: Orchestrating skill: classifies a task, routes it to the right specialised skill chain, and keeps durable multi-session workstream state
